name: Mezzo Pollo Academy
pitch: A plush half-chicken runs three lanes and must pass under the gate with the right half: numbers, words and mirrored shapes. When the WHOLE CHICKEN flies over, don't move.
access: Playing requires at least 1,000,000 MEMEZZO (1000000000000 raw units, six decimals) summed across active locks of the same connected Phantom wallet and exact Solana mainnet mint Dv1prgxPZs1M6vpacCzmGjLkd7ZFZVJSHCH9PLwEpump in DevFridge program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6. No minimum original or remaining duration; unlockAt must be strictly in the future. Each new run starts with floor(active MEMEZZO / 1,000,000) total lives, with no base lives: 1,000,000 gives 1, 1,999,999 gives 1, 2,000,000 gives 2. Starting lives are fixed for the run; refresh/resume never refills them. Balance changes that remain above threshold affect the next run only. Lost eligibility, disconnect, stale evidence or errors pause and block continuation until fresh qualifying evidence returns for the same wallet; switching wallets requires a new run. No free play or cosmetic-only unlock. Browser-side checks, no server authentication or verified scores. The game reads locks and requests no signatures/transactions. Players create/redeem externally on DevFridge: no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee for PASTA buy-and-burn plus network costs; MEMEZZO redemption requires an executable Jupiter route. Wallet features for adults.
limitations: Static Three.js r128 prototype. Local unverified scores; no server-authenticated session, leaderboard, rewards, multiplayer or seasonal challenges. Mandatory access and total starting lives are browser-side. The revised access/life rule passed 43 unit checks, 53 access browser checks and 7 death-timer checks with synthetic wallet/lock evidence; these do not establish real-wallet approval or mainnet transaction success. Mint decimals/extensions and SDK API were reviewed read-only; qualifying wallet scenarios used explicit fixtures, not a real mainnet transaction. Earlier phone portrait/landscape checks are emulation; no physical-phone, real Phantom approval, screen-lock, sustained-performance or real-chain transaction testing. SDK API can cache data and return an empty array on upstream RPC failure; sufficient locks then remain unconfirmed and access is denied. Procedural art, synthesized SFX and Google Lyria soundtrack and 43 English subtitle cues with documented provenance; 26 caption browser checks passed. Silent gameplay videos predate music/wallet integration and are historical evidence. Three.js MIT; Google Fonts SIL OFL. Gallery review is not final competition eligibility.
